name: Silver Shell Bastion
introDiscord: Interlocked silver shells form a bastion guarding a forgotten Moonkeeper route.
introTwitch: Interlocked silver shells form a bastion guarding a forgotten Moonkeeper route.

argent-causeway.name: Argent Causeway
argent-causeway.prompt: An argent causeway reaches a fortified junction with three unmarked approaches.

left.message: Shizuki wedged a weathered field kit into the coral at Argent Causeway. Its surviving bottle is labeled: "Sentry-salve. Quiet feet are healthier feet."
left.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's field kit at Argent Causeway can remain closed; you have no wounds for it to mend.

right.message: Within Silver Shell Bastion, the right path from Argent Causeway reveals a hidden Moonkeeper cache.

forward.message: The water folds around Silver Shell Sentry, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

sentry-rampart.name: Sentry Rampart
sentry-rampart.prompt: Shell ramparts rise through the water while three passages continue beneath watchful carvings.

left.message: The water folds around Silver Shell Sentry, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

right.message: A careful survival cache waits beyond Sentry Rampart, signed with Shizuki's crooked arrow mark. The remedy bears a warning: "Drink now. The silver shells count footsteps."
right.fullHpMessage: The remedy in Sentry Rampart stays in its cache. For once, preparation is all you need.

forward.message: Within Silver Shell Bastion, the forward path from Sentry Rampart reveals a hidden moon-shell coffer.

moonplate-keep.name: Moonplate Keep
moonplate-keep.prompt: Moonplate walls enclose a keep where three gates stand equally still.

left.message: Within Silver Shell Bastion, the left path from Moonplate Keep reveals a hidden Fae offering vessel.

right.message: The water folds around Silver Shell Sentry, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

forward.message: Shizuki sealed one Berry inside a spare lockpick pouch at Moonplate Keep: "Reward for opening the wrong door correctly."

boss-antechamber.name: Castellan Watch
boss-antechamber.prompt: A powerful presence shifts beyond the final threshold while the surrounding reef falls still.

bossPromptDiscord:
You reach Castellan Watch. The water tightens around an unseen guardian whose presence fills the chamber.
Use /yes to continue or /no to retreat for now.
bossPromptTwitch: Castellan Watch: An unseen guardian stirs beyond the threshold. Use !yes to continue or !no to retreat.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Castellan Watch. The hidden guardian remains beyond the threshold.

boss.revealText: The chamber answers with a surge of reef magic. Argent Shell Castellan reveals itself!

completionText: Argent Shell Castellan yields to the returning current. Silver Shell Bastion settles into a quieter rhythm, and another route through the Moonlit Reef becomes clear.
